props.subTitle: A Personalized Experience
props.title: What Makes Bali Moon Facial Different?
props.text: Bali Moon Facial is our signature facial treatment designed to refresh, hydrate, and support healthy-looking skin while providing a relaxing spa experience. The treatment combines gentle cleansing, steaming, exfoliation, lymphatic facial massage using Argan Oil, and a targeted mask selected according to your skin's needs.
props.feature1Text: Helps balance excess oil, calm blemishes, and support clearer-looking skin.
props.feature2Text: Focuses on hydration, elasticity, and restoring a healthy-looking glow.

props.subTitle: Find Yours

props.text: Bali Moon Facial is often combined with massage, hair treatments, and nail care to create a complete self-care experience. Our treatment packages are designed for guests looking to relax while giving their skin additional attention during their time in Bali.

props.subTitle: Your Skin Moment
props.title: Bali Moon Facial Options
props.text: We offers two facial treatment options, giving you a simple choice depending on the type of facial you prefer. Both treatments follow our complete facial care routine and are available as individual sessions.

props.subTitle: Skin Goals
props.title: What Does a Facial Help With?
props.text: While every skin type behaves differently, regular facial treatments are commonly used to help manage surface impurities, maintain hydration, and support overall skin condition. Guests choose facial treatments for a variety of skincare goals, such as:
featuresLeft: Helps remove excess oil and impurities
featuresRight: May improve the appearance of dull skin
Supports a fresher and brighter complexion

props.subTitle: Your Skin Type
props.title: Which Mask is Right for Your Skin?
props.text: The right mask depends on what your skin needs at the time of your treatment. Tea Tree and Gold masks offer different benefits, making them suitable for different skin types and concerns. We can help you choose the most appropriate option based on your skin's condition:
featuresLeft: Tea Tree for oily and congested skin
Gold for dry or dehydrated skin
featuresRight: Gold for softening and comforting the skin
Tea Tree or Gold for combination skin, depending on your needs
Gold may be suitable for skin affected by sun exposure

props.subTitle: Inside the Treatment
props.title: What to Expect During Your Facial
props.text: Your facial follows a series of carefully selected steps designed to cleanse, exfoliate, nourish, and refresh your skin:
featuresLeft: Milk cleanser to remove surface buildup
Warm steam to soften and prepare the pores
Red clay scrub for gentle exfoliation
featuresRight: Tea Tree or Gold Mask application
Rose water toning to finish the treatment

items.question: What Is a Bali Moon Facial?
items.answer: A Bali Moon Facial is a relaxing facial treatment designed to cleanse, refresh, and nourish the skin while providing a soothing spa experience in Seminyak, Bali.

items.question: Can a facial help after spending time in the Bali sun?
items.answer: Yes. After days of sightseeing, swimming, or sun exposure, a facial can help cleanse the skin, restore moisture, and leave your complexion feeling refreshed. Many visitors choose a facial as part of their post-holiday self-care routine.

items.question: What Are the Benefits of a Bali Moon Facial?
items.answer: A Bali Moon Facial can help cleanse the skin, remove surface impurities, improve hydration, and leave the skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

items.question: Where Can I Get a Bali Moon Facial in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can enjoy a Bali Moon Facial at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, Bali, as a relaxing spa experience designed to combine professional facial care with the calming atmosphere of a Balinese spa.
